canonical_project: 1414 Degrees Aurora Energy Precinct AI Data Centre (unnamed operator)
owner: 1414 Degrees (ASX:14D) with unnamed data centre operator
notes: Aurora Energy Precinct: 15.8 km2 Crown-sponsored approved industrial site, Upper Spencer Gulf REZ, ~20 min north of Port Augusta on Stuart Hwy (coords -32.32609, 137.61742). Jul 2025 non-binding HoA with unnamed Australian DC operator for up to 1GW AI capacity; staged rollout - initial ~17MW modular campus, ramp to ~200MW once 275kV connection built, ultimate ~1GW. Anchor 140MW/280MWh BESS approved (AEMO GPS accepted Jan 2026; ElectraNet transmission negotiations Jun 2026). LGA caveat: site may fall in Pastoral Unincorporated Area rather than City of Port Augusta LGA - verify via planning records.
